newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PT Komunikasi Selular gets $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: PT Komunikasi Selular gets $100 mln loan.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications company PT Komunikasi Selular Indonesia said on Friday it had raised US$100 million through a syndicated loan facility from the Asian dollar market.
The company said in a statement the loan was arranged by HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd, Singapore branch.

PT Komunikasi Selular is a joint venture company of PT Elektrindo Nusantara, which is part of the Bimantara group, and PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia, which is listed on the New York, London and Jakarta stock exchanges, the statement said.
There are 24 participating lenders in the loan, it said.
